value.answer: Honestly it's a tie between two. Toyota Sienna is the one most reviewers keep picking right now, and it's hybrid-only with AWD available, so it's great on gas. Honda Odyssey is the other top pick, and it drives most like a car. Kia Carnival Hybrid is the value play: good mpg, the most cargo room, and the cheapest of the group. Which one wins for you depends on whether you care most about fuel, driving feel, price, or AWD. Those were the main things the reviews split on. Also, this is US pricing and availability, so check the details if you're somewhere else.
